title: An environmental risk assessment of contamination of lakes and rivers in Northern Ireland with pharmaceuticals, personal care products and drugs of abuse
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00435G, Paper
William Ross Hunter, Helena Rapp-Wright, William Francis, Margarita White, Alexandra K. Richardson, Cryshanthi Christy, Faye Shiels, Ciara Mellon-Kane, Eugene O'Kane, Yvonne McElarney, Heather Moore, Leon P. Barron
This study is a spatially comprehensive environmental risk assessment of 114 pharmaceuticals, personal care products and illicit drug residues in the surface waters of Northern Ireland.
